description:
Rowan Fitzgerald Auctioneers have been favoured with the sale of this most attractive terrace property situated on a generous sized site offering gardens to the front and rear. This family home enjoys an excellent location adjacent to schools, church etc., University Hospital Limerick, Raheen Business Park are all nearby. As well as being within walking distance to the city centre. There is off street parking. 

Accommodation includes: Ground Floor - Large Entrance Hall, Sitting Room, Dining Room, Guest WC and Kitchen. First Floor – 3 Bedrooms (2 Doubles, 1 Single) and Main Bathroom. 

Features include - PVC double glazed windows throughout. Oil fired central heating private gardens not overlooked with access from rear suitable for oil deliveries etc. Off Street Parking. Mains Water & Sewage. 

Oakview Drive is a very established and much sought after location positioned within very close proximity of all local amenities and is just 15 minutes’ walk from the city centre. No. 52 really must to be seen to be fully appreciated. For more information and to arrange a viewing please call Rachael or simply reply to this daft advert.
